name: remotion
summary: The video composition layer. Programmatic React + TypeScript → video output via ffmpeg. Native compositor binaries for darwin/linux/win/lambda. Captions, animation-utils, effects, codex-plugin, elevenlabs TTS integration, cloud-run + lambda render targets. Closes the multi-modal composition stack: SVG (2D vector) + ComfyUI (2D raster) + SpriteForge (sprite atlas) + Audio (Kokoro/Qwen3-TTS) + Godot (3D scenes) + Blender (3D bake) + Remotion (final video).
engine_pattern: monorepo of ~50 packages. Core composition is React components rendered via offscreen browser + ffmpeg encoding. Native compositor crates (.node addons) handle pixel pipeline. CLI exposes render commands; cloud-run + lambda packages enable distributed rendering.

key_packages.lambda: AWS Lambda render target — fan-out parallel frames
key_packages.discord-poster: post rendered videos to Discord (mirrors our third_party.discord pattern)

inbound_callers: (planned) workflow_generator with --target remotion → emit React component skeleton from workflow_card
(planned) endpoints.RoutingOperator action=render_video → fan to remotion lambda
outbound_calls: elevenlabs API (when TTS pass is wired)
AWS Lambda / GCP Cloud Run for distributed render
substrate_reads: studio/spriteforge/manifests/*.json (frames from sprite-sheet workflows feed video composition)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: studio/remotion/out/*.mp4 (final composed videos — anchorable to crystal chain when bridge lands)

the_complete_composition_stack.avatar_realtime: MediaPipe → AnimateAnyone → Wav2Lip (placeholders — workflow_card flagship references them)

guarantees: Pure TypeScript + React on the composition side — no opaque binary editor formats
Deterministic renders: same React component tree + same props = same video bytes (modulo ffmpeg encoder variance)
Fork from canonical remotion-dev monorepo — upstream patches mergeable
Native compositor binaries already vendored per platform (no missing builds)
fork_notes: Cloned via `gh repo clone Zero2oneZ/remotion`. The 'all Sui for video compositing' framing suggests this Zero2oneZ fork is intended to (or will) carry Sui chain anchoring of render artifacts. Standard remotion-dev packages are intact; check `codex-plugin` for the differentiating piece.
next_wedge: workflow_generator with --target remotion emits a React component skeleton from a workflow_card. Six surfaces in total: streamlit + godot_scene + godot_gd + godot_cpp + blender + spriteforge + comfyui + remotion = 8 surfaces, one card.
